title: Best App Preview Video Creators (2026): How to Hire One
h1: Best App and Website Preview Video Creators
description: How to hire someone to make app store preview videos or website demos: requirements, formats, what to include, price factors and red flags.
intro: App and website preview videos show a product in action in a few seconds, on app store pages, landing pages and ads. Good previews highlight the main benefit quickly and follow each store's rules. They go wrong when they show features the app does not have, ignore store size and length requirements, or are too fast to understand. This guide helps you get previews that convert viewers into users.

faq.q: Do app stores have rules for preview videos?
faq.a: Yes. App stores set rules on length, resolution, content and what can be shown, such as requiring footage from the actual app. Check the current rules for each store.

faq.q: What should the preview show first?
faq.a: The main benefit or key action, within the first seconds. Many viewers see only the start.

faq.q: Do I need different versions for each device?
faq.a: Often, yes. Stores may require specific sizes for different phones and tablets.
Design it to work without sound, since many people watch muted. Add captions or on-screen text.

faq.q: Can a preview use mockups or animation?
faq.a: Rules vary by store. Some require real app footage. For websites and ads, mockups and animation are common.
